items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: The interviewee only responds with 'Mm-hm' to the interviewer's statement about Willenberg-Joy; no personal interaction or relationship is described by the interviewee.

ctx.x: Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm.
